newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bank H1 net profit $29.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bank H1 net profit $29.8 mln.

text.p: Morocco's Banque Morocaine du Commerce Exterieur (BMCE) made a net profit of 259.3 million dirhams ($29.8 million) in the first half of 1996, up 17.7 percent on the same period last year, figures published on Thursday showed.

The bank, reporting on operations for Morocco, its Paris agency and Tanger free zone, said deposits rose in the first half of 1996 to 23.3 billion dirhams against 21.9 billion, giving it 14.3 percent of the market against 12.4 percent.

Earlier in 1996, the bank increased its capital to 443 million dirhams, through incoporation of reserves, a share distribution of two new shares for each seven old ones, and a $60 million international issue of Global Depository Receipts.
